ENTITLED:“AN ORDINANCE REPEALING ORDINANCE NO.3408, ASAMENDED,
WHICH ADOPTED THE'CHEYENNE-LARAMIE COUNTY SUBDIVISION
/DEVELOPMENT REGULATIONS2000,'AND REPEALING ORDINANCE
17, ZONING, OF THE CHEYENNE CITY CODE2002, IN ITS ENTIRETY,
AND ADOPTING THE^CHEYENNE UNIFIED DEVELOPMENT CODE,'
INCORPORATED HERE IN BY REFERENCE."
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE CITY OF CHEYENNE,
WYOMING:
Section 1.That Ordinance No. 3408, as amended, which adopted the “Cheyenne-Laramie
County Subdivision/Development Regulations 2000,”and Ordinance No. 3720, as amended, which
adopted the “2006 Road, Street, and Site Planning Design Standards,” and Title 17, Zoning, of the
Cheyenne City Code 2002, in its entirety, are hereby repealed.
Section 2.That the City of Cheyenne Planning Commission held a public hearing on
December 5, 2011, concerning the proposed “Cheyenne Unified Development Code,” which was
appropriately advertised to the public.
Section 3. That the Planning Commission recommended approval ofthe“Cheyenne Unified
Development Code,”attached as Exhibit A to this ordinance, at its December 5, 2011 meeting.
Section4.That the“Cheyenne Unified Development Code”ishereby adopted in its entirety
as referred to and provided in Exhibit A attached hereto, and fully incorporated herein by reference.
Section5.That this ordinances hall beinfull force and effect upon approval and publication.
